items.title: Microsoft: Windows 10 KB5068781 ESU update may fail with 0x800f0922 errors
items.description: Microsoft has confirmed it is investigating a bug causing the Windows 10 KB5068781 extended security update to fail to install with 0x800f0922 errors on devices with corporate licensing. [...]

items.title: Decades-old ‘Finger’ protocol abused in ClickFix malware attacks
items.description: The decades-old "finger" command is making a comeback,, with threat actors using the protocol to retrieve remote commands to execute on Windows devices. [...]

items.title: Jaguar Land Rover cyberattack cost the company over $220 million
items.description: Jaguar Land Rover (JLR) published its financial results for July 1 to September 30, warning that the cost of a recent cyberattack totaled £196 million ($220 million) in the quarter. [...]
